title: Chapter 435 Meet The Young Master
content:
Chapter 435 Meet The Young Master

At the top of the list, I had already reached the top of the list without realizing it.

More importantly, he can still reap unexpected joys.

Without thinking too much, Bai Xu reached out to touch the light source.

The next moment, the light dissipated, and an irregular white ball of meat appeared in front of Bai Xu.

"Supreme Taoist fetus!" Bai Xu's eyes widened and he couldn't help but say in disbelief.

At this time, the sentient beings were already in a turmoil.

"That white tiger in the Heavenly Demon Clan can actually hit the top of the list. It's really terrifying."

"Maybe it's just that the genius on the list now has no value."

"No value? Didn't you see that Zhang Changfan was defeated?"

Zhang Changfan is known as the peerless genius who has not been out of a thousand years. He is the most beloved disciple of the famous strong man Daoyan. Among the younger generation, he is definitely a top genius who cannot be ignored.

And the unknown Bai Xu was able to defeat Zhang Changfan and even kill him, which is enough to show how evil this White Tiger is.

At this time, Zhang Changfan's figure had already appeared in the Huangcheng Square.

Zhang Changfan was not surprised that he could be resurrected from the dead. Obviously, his first place was not picked up, but beaten.

But unlike Bai Xu, he hit it from the middle.

If Zhang Changfan was like Bai Xu, he would have come one step late, perhaps the person who won the encouragement award on the Tianjiao List would not be Bai Xu, but him.

"Changfan."

Hearing someone calling him, Zhang Changfan turned his head indifferently to look.

When Zhang Changfan saw the visitor, he was slightly stunned and quickly saluted, "I have seen Master."

The Supreme Daoyan, the Supreme Holy Grade Heaven.

This time, the Supreme Emperor of Daoyan came out of seclusion not only to see Zhang Changfan, but also to the combat power list.

With the strength of the Supreme Emperor of Daoyan, he will naturally be on the list.

Seeing Zhang Changfan's expression depressed, Supreme Master Daoyan sighed slightly and said softly: "Changfan, you don't have to be so discouraged, it's just a temporary win or loss. Maybe one day, when your cultivation breaks through, whoever wins and loses, then it will be It's unknown."

When everyone around him heard this, they nodded slightly.

It's just a temporary win or loss.

There are many such examples in the Chaos Realm.

Two strong men of different races often fought, from the realm of creation to the realm of immortality, but one of them had never won. At that time, everyone felt that the person who had been failing would be suppressed by the other person for the rest of his life.

But later, it was not the case. The two were promoted to supreme one after another and then fought again.

But this time, the man who had never lost before was defeated.

From then on, he could no longer defeat that opponent.

This true story tells the world that winning or losing at the moment is nothing, and laughing to the end is the most important thing.

Everyone thought Zhang Changfan would regain his confidence, and since then he sang all the way, but Zhang Changfan's face became even lower after hearing this, and sighed heavily, saying, "That white tiger is now just a prophet realm."

Prophet realm.

As soon as these words came out, the surroundings suddenly became quiet.

Everyone opened their mouths slightly, their faces full of disbelief.

It was not until the laughter of the powerful Tiande Clan that the calmness was broken.

No wonder Zhang Changfan is like this. He usually fights against others at a higher level, but this time, he was killed by a younger generation who is lower than his cultivation level. No one can recover for a while.

Daoyan Tianzun was also extremely surprised. As Zhang Changfan’s master, Daoyan Tianzun was very clear about his disciple’s ability and could defeat his disciple’s existence, and he knew it in his heart.

But there is no Bai Xu.

It seems that there are still many very low-key geniuses in this world.

This Bai Xu may be the personal disciple that the Heavenly Demon Clan has been secretly cultivating.

And at this moment, the space trembled, and Bai Xu's figure was revealed by the genius list and appeared in front of everyone.

For a moment, everyone's eyes gathered together and looked at Bai Xu.

"It turns out to be in the prophet realm. At this age, his body of qi and blood are already so powerful. He is worthy of being the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon."

A powerful human race looked at Bai Xu and commented.

"Young Master Bai Xu!"

At this time, several powerful men from the Heavenly Demon Clan stepped forward and surrounded Bai Xu, fearing that other powerful men of the tribes present would secretly attack.

Even if this is in the deserted city, they are not very relieved.

Seeing these powerful people of the same clan with powerful aura, Baihu was not afraid at all, but was still a little confused, "Seniors, you guys,"

Bai Xu just spoke, but a powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan grabbed Bai Xu's hands and burst into tears, "Young Master Bai Xu, you made us suffer so much, wuwu."

"ah?"

"Young Master Bai Xu, why don't you go to the clan? With your talent, the clan will definitely do your best to cultivate you?"

Another powerful man from the Heavenly Demon Clan asked in confusion.

Hearing this, Bai Xu chuckled, "This matter is a long story."

After leaving his sister, Bai Xu planned to go to the core area of the Tian Yao Clan, but he met Senior Hao on the way.

After obtaining the inheritance of Senior Hao and successfully awakening Senior Hao, Bai Xu has been under the guidance of Senior Hao to various extremely dangerous places to improve his strength, and at the same time is also looking for ways to restore Senior Hao's strength and body.

As if he had thought of something, Bai Xu looked around and whispered, "Seniors, it's a bit inconvenient to speak here."

Hearing this, one of the powerful men of the Tiandemon Clan nodded and took Bai Xu and the other big monsters to leave here temporarily.

After Bai Xu left, the square returned to peace.

At this time, after the Tianjiao List was launched, the combat power list seemed to be about to enter the climax.

Even the strong men like Daoyan Supreme who have been in seclusion for many years have come out of seclusion, and those strong men who truly stand at the top of the Chaos Realm may not appear soon.

The Haohan Ancestor, who was once at the top of the combat power list, has been squeezed out now.

The other strong men who reached the top of the list were squeezed down again in no time.

The strong man who can truly stand at the top of the list has not yet appeared.

With the addition of the Supreme Emperor of Daoyan, the ranking of the combat power list changed again.

At this time, somewhere in the deserted city.

Bai Xu looked at the powerful people in the clan, paused slightly, and said softly: "Senior Hao?"

Buzz —

Under the shocked gaze of several demons, the bracelet on Bai Xu's wrist lit up slightly, and then slowly floated in front of the demons.

A glimmer of light flashed.

A man with a gray hair and a messy beard, but a handsome face appeared in front of the demons.

"You, who are you?"

A strong man from the Heavenly Demon Clan with the deepest aura asked.

At this moment, they were all a little scared. None of them could sense it.

This person's aura is a bit illusory, but he must have been a peak powerhouse.
